description: Use when an agent needs to see what a Solana or Base transaction does before signing it. Returns simulated balance changes, programs or contracts, approvals, new accounts, token-risk reads and warnings. 503 if it cannot simulate: not charged. Costs 0.05 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

chain.description: the chain of the transaction: solana or base

data.description: chain=base: calldata as 0x hex, at most 20000 hex characters (default 0x)

from.description: chain=base: the sender, a 0x address (default: a placeholder sender that holds nothing)

to.description: chain=base: the 0x address the transaction calls

tx.description: chain=solana: the transaction as base64, legacy or version 0, signed or unsigned, at most 1232 bytes

value.description: chain=base: wei to send, decimal or 0x hex (default 0)

name: get_tx_precheck

data.description: the get_tx_precheck payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_tx_precheck

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: Transaction precheck
